summary: Modularize poa_io and harden relative symlink traversal, JSON digit/surrogate bounds, and process title controls

delivery.outcome: Extract standard/poa_io.py and rebalance standard/poa_primitives.py and standard/conformance.py well below 500 lines, reject relative symlink-parent traversal via .., bound JSON integer digits before int() conversion, reject lone UTF-16 surrogates in reject_secret_material and ASCII C0/DEL control characters in validate_process title, expand standard/test_poa_hardening.py, and reconcile merged ticket-011.
nonGoals: Do not alter frozen POA JSON schemas, protobuf definitions, or GBNF grammars

architecture.decision: Split bounded regular-file UTF-8 I/O, finite JSON parsing, and secret scanning into standard/poa_io.py and move observation/binding/envelope validators into standard/poa_primitives.py with full __all__ re-exports so all standard/*.py files stay well under 500 lines.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch commit or close the pull request before merge.
